name: Clark County, OH
findings: Clark County has 466 nonprofit organizations. 178 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 149 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Clark County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 52 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 52 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Clark County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Few arts and cultural organizations list public events
observations.text: 2 arts and cultural organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through arts and cultural groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Youth organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 5 youth organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do youth organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
